assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq v2, HiSeq 2000) of vastus lateralis biopsies at 1000 hr, baseline and 72 hr after the last bout of 12 weeks training (S4.4.1.p1, S1.p3)
primary_estimand: within-subject change in muscle gene expression after 12 weeks of training (post vs pre), separately for each training mode (HIIT, RT, CT) within each age group (Young 18-30, Old 65-80) (S2.4.p1, FIG4 A-F)
planned_contrasts: Old HIIT post vs pre (FIG4B; paper: 553 genes increased, S2.4.p2/S2.6.p5)
Young RT post vs pre (FIG4C; 35% fewer up genes than young HIIT, S2.4.p1)
Old RT post vs pre (FIG4D; 70% fewer up genes than old HIIT, ~166)
Young CT post vs pre (FIG4E; 28% fewer up genes than young HIIT)
Old CT post vs pre (FIG4F; 84% fewer up genes than old HIIT, ~88)
Baseline Old vs Young (S2.4.p1; 267 lower + 166 higher in old = 433), associational
repeated_measure_unit: participant (pre and post biopsy from the same person)
inclusion: all participants with RNA-seq at both timepoints; CT pre-training = post-SED biopsy (B), the pre-SED (A) biopsy is not deposited
paper_method: not stated for RNA-seq (MapRSeq pipeline, 'as previously described (Lanza et al., 2012)'); comparisons are per mode-by-age pre vs post
